title: Bend, OR — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Bend, OR: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Bend is a city in OR with a population of 99,178. Outdoor playground with breweries, skiing, and no sales tax in the high desert. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
